nameJa: コミュニティの温かさ
headline:
Fullscreen
Live Chat
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Make ONE polished Chrome extension store listing tile, exact 1760x1120px landscape ratio11:7. A premium, warm, community-focused YouTube-native livestream identity. Full bleed very dark charcoal background with a thin red accent. At upper left huge clean condensed white title on two lines "Fullscreen" / "Live Chat" (Fullscreen is ONE word). Use vivid red for the words Live Chat, white for Fullscreen. Very large, perfectly spelled, highest contrast, readable in a tiny 440x280 store card. No other slogan.
Below and partly behind headline, a SINGLE wide ORIGINAL warm hand-painted animated streaming video scene: a cozy outdoor campsite under orange dusk, a little original robot playing guitar beside a campfire and striped tent, rolling pine hills, fireflies. Friendly, cinematic, entertainment-centric and original, no real creator, no existing IP, no physical screen or room. Video field fills most of tile with subtle16pxcorners. On the right INSIDE the video place a SINGLE true-to-YouTube dark native live chat overlay approximately 32%wide, modest 8pxcorners and #0f0f0f surface, no broad shadow, no outer device.
Use provided image solely as STYLE REFERENCE for how native YouTube chat looks. Header "Top chat" with small down chevron and three-dot menu. EIGHT COMPACT NATIVE FLAT ROWS. Every row: tiny circular profileavatar then muted gray @handle followed by white comment INLINE on the SAME row; some wrap to a second line. No colorful speechbubbles or messagecards, no skeleton bars. Fictional sample messages: @brook This is so cozy, @milo Love this song, @sora Campfire crew 🔥, @winter Perfect evening, @ava Good vibes, @rory That little robot!, @sage Singing along, @leo What a stream. EXACTLY ONE member row: @sora name tinted green with one tiny green round badge, keep its message WHITE and same row. EXACTLY ONE moderator row: @winter handle blue with tiny wrench, WHITE comment inline. Others gray handles. This is native YouTube conversation, not Discord, Twitch, Slack, iMessage or floating social cards. No donation/superchat card. Small comfortable white UI type, gray handles, compact rows, spacing from actual reference.
Composerfooter: own tiny circle avatar, restrained underlined "Chat..." field, simple small smiley, small outlined sendtriangle. No huge inputbubble. Must show product benefit of keeping native community in fullscreenvideo. No logos, no viewer counts, no fake official endorsement, no YouTube playmark, no trophies, no physical monitor/hardware. Do NOT copy any realperson,game,sourcehandle or actual message from reference. Whole image is an illustrative product promotion, not a real screenshot.
conceptNote: キャンプの音楽配信と、メンバー・モデレーター表示を含むYouTube風の会話。
